expectedSkips.reason: Native Windows assertions run in windows-native and are not native proof here
The Windows ACK journal ACL assertion requires Windows and executes as a required zero-skip case in the selected windows-native stage; its Linux skip is not Windows security evidence
expectedSkips.pattern: ^Windows ACK journal has protected ACLs limited to the current user and SYSTEM$

expectedSkips.reason: Linux filesystem secret permissions are checked on the Linux CI host; Windows diagnostic execution cannot qualify them
expectedSkips.pattern: ^Linux secret file rejects readable-by-others, directories, symlinks and oversized input$

expectedSkips.reason: Windows does not expose portable executable mode semantics; the exact executable-mode assertion must execute in the Linux CI and Linux Docker qualification, and its Windows skip is not POSIX permission evidence
expectedSkips.pattern: ^executable mode is bound when the platform exposes mode bits$
